# Phase 01.1 Plan 08: Re-skin the Ten Pre-existing Primitives Summary

The ten primitives that shipped before this phase now carry the Cena visual language, completing all
19; every in-primitive glyph draws through `Icon` at the 1.75 stroke; and the touch-floor gate was
extended from 8 derived cases to 13, catching two genuine under-floor defects on the way.

## What Was Built

**Form controls (Task 1).** `input` takes the Body role (16px/400), the paper surface, a
control-border boundary and `h-11` + `min-h-11`; its header records the enforceable rule that no
control renders on the chip surface, because `--cena-border-control` measures 3.55:1 on paper and
3.14:1 on sunken but only 2.75:1 on chip. `label` moves to `text-label`, retiring the `font-medium`
(500) that was the product's only third weight. `checkbox` keeps its 16px painted box and gains a
correct 44×44 hit area.

**Content primitives (Task 2).** `card` keeps `overflow-hidden` with the reason now written in the
file, takes a decorative-rule border in place of an opacity-derived ring, and renders titles at the
Heading role in serif. `badge` rises from 12px/500 to the Label role and gives up its accent fill.
`alert` moves its informational variant to sunken and its destructive variant onto the measured
danger-soft pair, with a header recording that status colours are Cena-fixed on every surface,
permanently.

**Overlays, glyphs and the gate (Task 3).** `dialog` takes the tisza-tinted `--shadow-overlay` and
honours reduced motion through `--duration-base`. `dropdown-menu`'s four pressable rows reach the
floor. `avatar`'s fallback moves to sunken with body-ink initials. `sonner` is re-skinned in place
onto the Cena status tokens via sonner's own CSS-variable API.

## Coverage: the Icon Migration Is 19 of 19

Plan 01.1-07 established this as a nineteen-file migration. Its own plan migrated `select.tsx` (three
glyphs) because that file did not exist when this plan's ten-primitive scope was drawn. This plan
migrated the remaining four in-primitive call sites — `checkbox` (1), `dialog` (1), `dropdown-menu`
(3), `sonner` (5), ten glyphs in total. A repo-wide grep for a bare Lucide element under
`components/ui/` now returns nothing. The fourteen **surface** call sites remain with plans
01.1-09..12 as planned; this plan claims no credit for them.

## The Two Reds, Observed Before Being Fixed

**Checkbox, observed during Task 1.** Adding the row to the derived table produced, verbatim:

> SC3 VIOLATION — Checkbox (components/ui/checkbox.tsx) has a hit area 32px tall, below the 44px
> floor. painted box: 16px / expander: 8px per side

`after:-inset-x-3 after:-inset-y-2` on a `size-4` box is 40×32. `after:-inset-3.5` is 16 + 28 = 44 on
both axes. The assertion was left at full strength; the defect was fixed, not the test.

**Dropdown menu rows, observed during Task 3.** All four pressable rows failed at once:

> SC3 VIOLATION — DropdownMenuItem (components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx) has a hit area 0px tall, below
> the 44px floor. painted box: none declared / expander: 0px per side

They declared `py-1` and no height at all. This is the more valuable of the two reds: an implicit
height is one nobody checks, and the parser reporting `0px` rather than guessing is what made it
visible. Fixed with `min-h-11` — the painted-box mechanism, because a menu row is a full-width band
and painting it at 44px is what it should be, not a distortion of what it is.

## Deviations from Plan

### Approved by the orchestrator before execution

**1. [Approved] `components/ui/button.tsx` focus ring 50% → 30% alpha.**
- **Why:** the tracer shipped the registry's stock half-opacity ring; the contract (UI-SPEC lines 229
  and 314) is 30%. The alpha cannot be fixed at the token layer — `--ring: var(--cena-accent)` is
  central, but the opacity lives on the utility — so each primitive writes it. Leaving Button at 50%
  would ship two focus treatments across nineteen primitives.
- **Scope:** one utility class, plus a header note. Nothing else in the file changed.
- **Commit:** 54f3454

**2. [Approved] The checkbox touch-target red is a defect to fix, not a test to relax.** Applied
exactly as directed: `after:-inset-3.5`, assertion untouched. See above.

**3. [Approved] The icon migration is a nineteen-file job.** `select.tsx` was not redone; it is
accounted for in the coverage section above.

### Auto-fixed during execution

**4. [Rule 2 - Missing critical functionality] `components/venue-form.tsx`: `min-h-11` on each
language-checkbox row.**
- **Found during:** Task 1, immediately after correcting the checkbox expander.
- **Issue:** the corrected expander claims 14px beyond the painted box on every side — a 44px hit
  area on a roughly 20px row. The venue form stacks those rows at `gap-2` (8px), giving a pitch of
  about 28px, so **adjacent hit areas would have overlapped by roughly 16px**. The owner presses one
  language and toggles another, which is worse than a small target because it looks like it worked.
  My own fix introduced this; it did not exist before.
- **Fix:** `min-h-11` on the row, making the pitch 44 + 8 = 52px so the areas tile with neither
  overlap nor dead space. This is the same correction `radio-group.tsx` makes at the group level with
  `gap-7`, and it matches the composed `Field` shape where the row already carries the floor.
- **Note:** `components/venue-form.tsx` is a surface file owned by a later plan. This is a one-class
  addition with a comment; it does not re-skin the file and should merge cleanly with 01.1-09..12.
- **Commit:** 39e6819

**5. [Rule 1 - Bug] A stray `default:` key in `badge.tsx`'s cva `variants` object.**
- **Found during:** Task 2, immediately after writing the file — self-inflicted, caught before any
  test ran.
- **Issue:** a variant group named `default` at the top level of `variants`, which is not the shape
  cva expects.
- **Fix:** moved inside the `variant` group where it belongs.
- **Commit:** de84a3a

**6. [Rule 1 - Bug] A banned literal quoted inside an explanatory comment in `button.tsx`.**
- **Found during:** the Task 3 phase-wide audit.
- **Issue:** the comment explaining that the superseded 50%-alpha ring is gone **quoted the value**,
  so a grep proving its absence would have matched the comment and returned a false positive. This is
  the failure mode the execution brief called out as having already cost two plans.
- **Fix:** the superseded value is now described rather than written out, and the comment says why.
  `grep -rn "ring-ring/50" components/ui` now returns nothing, so the gate is meaningful again.
- **Commit:** 54f3454

### Plan constant corrected

**7. `dropdown-menu.tsx` has SEVENTEEN `data-slot` declarations, not twenty.** The plan's acceptance
criterion asserts 20. The base commit also has 17, and the sorted slot sets before and after the
re-skin are **byte-identical** — verified by diff, not by count. The invariant the gate reaches for
(no slot added, none dropped) holds exactly; the constant in the plan is a miscount of the file. This
is recorded so a verifier reads a planner arithmetic slip rather than a missing slot. `card` (7) and
`alert` (4) matched their stated counts exactly.

### Ordering deviation

**8. The touch-floor gate was extended across two tasks rather than only in Task 3.** The plan puts
the whole test extension in Task 3, but the checkbox row belongs to the checkbox fix in Task 1 — and
observing its red requires adding the row *before* the fix. Adding it in Task 3 would have meant
adding a row that could only ever be green, which is not an observation. Each red was therefore
observed against the control it belongs to. Both reds are quoted verbatim above.

## Focus-Ring Uniformity

`grep -rn "ring-ring/50" components/ui` returns nothing, including comments. Ten of the nineteen
primitives declare a focus ring, and all ten are `focus-visible:ring-ring/30`:

`button`, `input`, `checkbox`, `badge`, `select`, `radio-group`, `switch`, `tabs`, `tooltip`,
`dropdown-menu` (added this plan).

The remaining nine — `alert`, `avatar`, `card`, `dialog`, `field`, `label`, `separator`, `sonner`,
`tag` — declare none, because none contains a focusable element of its own. `Dialog`'s close
affordance is a `Button` and inherits the ring along with the 44px floor; that reuse is why the
`buttonVariants` import in `dialog.tsx` is load-bearing rather than incidental.

**Out of scope, flagged for the surface plans:** three `ring-ring/50` occurrences survive outside
`components/ui/` — `components/venue-form.tsx` (2, on its native selects) and
`app/(dashboard)/components/venue-switcher-menu.tsx` (1). Those are surface files owned by plans
01.1-09..12 and were deliberately not touched here.

## Contract Points a Careless Edit Breaks (now recorded in-file)

Each of these is written into the primitive's own header, where the next reader will be:

- `card.tsx` — why `overflow-hidden` is load-bearing: it is what turned the `max-w-md` token defect
  from merely ugly into a login form clipped out of both paint **and** hit-testing.
- `alert.tsx` — status colours are Cena-fixed on every surface, permanently, and must never join the
  `--venue-*` namespace. A themable warning can be made invisible.
- `sonner.tsx` — text on the napfeny fill is always `--cena-warning-ink`. Never black, never body ink.
- `input.tsx` — no control renders on the chip surface; the boundary token fails 3:1 there.
- `checkbox.tsx` — the expander arithmetic, written out, and why the Radix state shorthand stays.
- `dialog.tsx` — the close affordance reuses Button so the floor propagates rather than drifting.
- `badge.tsx` / `tag.tsx` — the display-only exemption and its boundary: a dietary **filter** chip is
  a control and is not exempt.
